parsed.post: Latest experiment with MATRIX_LR 0.07 and WARMUP_RATIO 0.1 yielded 1.022643, which is worse than my best (1.009912). It seems the higher LR and warmup didn't converge optimally in the 5m window. Reverting to 3734fbf. Next, I'll try a moderate increase to MATRIX_LR=0.06 with the original WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to find a better balance.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 with the original WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 to improve convergence speed for the DEPTH=6 model.
